dark.--theme-logo-fill: linear-gradient(118deg, rgb(240 171 252) 0%, oklch(from rgb(240 171 252) calc(l - 0.08) calc(c * 1.15) h) 32%, oklch(from rgb(240 171 252) calc(l - 0.16) calc(c * 1.3) h) 64%, oklch(from rgb(240 171 252) calc(l - 0.24) calc(c * 1.4) h) 100%)
dark.--theme-selected-control-border: color-mix(in srgb, oklch(from rgb(240 171 252) calc(l - 0.041) calc(c * 1.35) h) 46%, transparent)
dark.--theme-selected-control-bg:
radial-gradient(circle at 18% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, rgb(255 255 255) 8%, color-mix(in srgb, #f0abfc 24%, #220c2a)), transparent 42%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, #f0abfc 24%, #220c2a), color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, rgb(240 171 252) 72%, #110617) 18%, #110617))
dark.--theme-selected-control-shadow:
0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, oklch(from rgb(240 171 252) calc(l - 0.041) calc(c * 1.35) h) 46%, transparent),
    0 12px 26px -22px color-mix(in srgb, #f0abfc 42%, transparent),
    inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, #ffffff 8%, transparent)
dark.--theme-selected-control-glow: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, #f0abfc 10%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, #f5d0fe 12%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, #f0abfc 10%, transparent))
dark.--theme-inline-reference-border: color-mix(in srgb, oklch(from rgb(240 171 252) calc(l - 0.041) calc(c * 1.35) h) 38%, transparent)

light.--theme-selected-control-highlight: color-mix(in srgb, oklch(100% 0 0) 68%, color-mix(in srgb, oklch(58% 0.155 326) 14%, oklch(94% 0.03 326)))
light.--theme-selected-control-bg:
radial-gradient(circle at 18% 0%, color-mix(in srgb, oklch(100% 0 0) 68%, color-mix(in srgb, oklch(58% 0.155 326) 14%, oklch(94% 0.03 326))), transparent 42%),
    linear-gradient(135deg, color-mix(in srgb, oklch(58% 0.155 326) 14%, oklch(94% 0.03 326)), color-mix(in srgb, oklch(46% 0.135 326) 12%, oklch(99.4% 0.002 326)))
light.--theme-selected-control-shadow:
0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, oklch(43% 0.205 326) 30%, transparent),
    0 12px 24px -22px color-mix(in srgb, oklch(43% 0.205 326) 34%, transparent),
    inset 0 1px 0 oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.72)
light.--theme-selected-control-glow: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in srgb, oklch(49% 0.19 326) 8%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, oklch(58% 0.155 326) 11%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, oklch(49% 0.19 326) 8%, transparent))
